verdict.rationale: Ramp ships AI features (Ramp Intelligence, agents that learn from past invoices, an MCP server), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a policy, setting, or contractual control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The community comments criticize Ramp's aggregate transaction analysis, not model training, and no vendor claim exists to contradict, so they do not move the verdict.
